== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Navigator ships]] are unique, one-of-a-kind Awakened vessels used by the [[Navigator’s Guild|Navigator's Guild]]. These ships are deeply connected to their captains, often described as being synonymous with a captain's soul. Because of their specialized nature, they generally cannot be operated by anyone other than a [[Navigator]]; if a crew is killed by an enemy, the vessel could be run aground as it would be impossible for others to sail. While many of these vessels are highly unusual in appearance—such as those featuring blue fins, bone-like structures, or even the form of a giant conch shell—they are all capable of traveling the [[Aion]]. Notable examples within the fleet include [[The Eternal]], which belongs to the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] and features red sails that leave trails of flame, and [[The Reliable]], a pink-and-seafoam colored ship shaped like an animated conch shell that is rumored to be unsinkable. Other distinct vessels include [[The Testament]], which has green sails, and [[Bastion's Shadow|Bastion’s Shadow]], a black wooden ship used by the [[Consultants]] that features a large, swiveling Elder eye in place of a crow's nest. There are also ships that do not belong to the [[Guild]], such as those used by the [[Consultants]] or [[Independents]], which may feature unique decorations like gold edging and snakeskins or unusual structures like crab carapaces.}}
